description: 2012 yil 9 aprelda Facebook 13 xodimli Instagram'ni taxminan 1 milliard dollarga (naqd pul va aksiyalar) sotib olishini e'lon qildi. Kevin Sistrom va Mayk Kriger ilovani 2010 yil oktabrida ishga tushirgan, u uch oydan kamroq vaqtda 1 million ro'yxatdan o'tgan foydalanuvchiga yetgan. Sizning jamoangiz qaysi bitta ishni eng yaxshi qiladi?
source: CNN Money, Facebook acquires Instagram for $1 billion (9 April 2012), https://money.cnn.com/2012/04/09/technology/facebook_acquires_instagram/index.htm ; Facebook newsroom, Facebook to Acquire Instagram (about $1 billion in cash and shares), https://about.fb.com/news/2012/04/facebook-to-acquire-instagram/amp/ ; CNBC, Facebook bought Instagram because it was scared of Twitter and Google (13 employees), https://www.cnbc.com/2019/09/24/facebook-bought-instagram-because-it-was-scared-of-twitter-and-google.html ; Business Insider, Instagram only had 13 employees when bought by Facebook, https://www.businessinsider.nl/instagram-first-13-employees-full-list-2020-4 ; TechCrunch, From 0 to $1 billion in two years (1 million users in under three months), https://techcrunch.com/2012/04/09/instagram-story-facebook-acquisition/ ; MacStories, Instagram reaches 1 million users, https://www.macstories.net/iphone/confirmed-instagram-reaches-1-million-users/
